read_first: only the issuer, team, people or institutional owners whose authority or availability changes the project
write_order: resolve the real institutional or contractual action first
update project/contract/mission registry status to mirror that resolved authority
create no mission, transfer, team or permission merely from a planning record
invariants: Projects record resolved planning state and never substitute for institutional authority.
OOC proposals and wishlists do not become active missions or assignments.
A project may become authorized only after the actual authority, staffing, obligations and blockers are resolved in their owning systems.
Formation of a team does not automatically create a mission.
